_README: What the feed STRUCTURALLY CANNOT SEE, per sport.
Rule 14 says the board is a floor and not a ceiling. It was written after
the board missed Walsh -630 and Plymouth -1100, and on 2026-08-13 it was
broken three times in one morning: 'there are five soccer matches today'
was said off the board alone while FanDuel was pricing roughly forty UEFA
qualifiers. Each time the board was read correctly. The board was simply
not the schedule, and nothing in the output said so.
A rule that lives only in RULES.md gets skipped under time pressure. This
file exists so the blind spots are printed BESIDE the count, every time, by
board.py itself -- the same way a stale MLBTool slate and an empty strikeout
ladder are printed rather than left to be remembered.
Keep it current with socdiag.py, which enumerates the live catalog in about
ninety seconds and is the authority for anything in here.

nfl.note: GROUNDED: nflhist.json holds 3028 modern games. Moneyline de-vig for NFL is POWER (1.47 vs mult 1.94 -- thin balanced overround, same family as soccer 1X2), totals de-vig mult at 0.75 pts, and spread_to_winprob translates 'laying 7' into a probability. Wire devig method BEFORE week 1: board.devig defaults mult, which is the ladder answer, not the moneyline answer.
